dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp, high-contrast outer perimeters with a steep gradient from dark exterior fur to lighter interiors. The geometry of the top three lateral rings is non-circular and elongated along the longitudinal axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate density of solid, small light-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the dorsal ridge and posterior flank, lacking internal tonal gradients and presenting as asymmetrical, sharp-edged points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent obtuse scalene triangle is formed by the centroids of the three largest annuli located on the mid-lateral flank. A secondary trapezoidal relationship exists between four distinct high-intensity blobs on the lower posterior region.

other_distinctive_markers: Elongated, vermiform (worm-like) light-colored markings are visible on the dorsal-cranial region, distinct from the circular annuli and solid blobs found elsewhere.
